notes.title: Play Lemuria: Lost in Space - unique sci-fi adventure full of mysteries and puzzles.

tags.feature: [B] Explore over 100 rooms[/b] of the spaceship, solve dozens of puzzles, find valuable resources and fight with security turrets and other enemies patrolling the ship;
[b] Uncover the story[/b] of the lost crew of Lemuria 7. The ship has been missing for over 70 years - find out what exactly happened to them;
[b] Acquire new skills[/b] allowing you to hack computer terminals or even the spaceship network to avoid fighting with patrolling robots;
[b] Challenge yourself in demanding mini-games[/b] that will test your logical thinking and maths skills;
[b] Feel the unique atmosphere[/b] of the abandoned spaceship with the original soundtrack, composed by Ree-D.

notes.title: Update 1.4 released!
notes.content:
Following your suggestions we have made many changes and bug fixes in the game. We encourage you to download the new version of Ferrum's secrets.

Update 1.4 contains:
[list]
[*] Speech texts stay much longer
[*] Enabled to skip speech texts
[*] Enabled to skip many cutscenes
[*] Fixed Hint button that sometimes didn't work in hidden-object locations
[*] Enabled to leave hidden-object locations and mini-games
[*] Instruction button more visible
[*] Showing mini-game instruction before game start
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.3 released!
notes.content:
We encourage you to download the new version of Ferrum's secrets.

Update 1.3 contains:
- Button "windowed mode" that enables switching between full screen and window
- Achievements will now be collected during game not after closing game
- Slower dialogues
- Fixed many minor bugs: glitches, translation bugs
